deals.headline: Walton-Penner family buys the Denver Broncos from the Pat Bowlen Trust
deals.summary: The Broncos and the Walton-Penner family signed a purchase and sale agreement on 7 June 2022 for the family to acquire the club from the Pat Bowlen Trust; NFL owners approved it unanimously in August 2022. NFL Network reported the winning bid at $4.65 billion.
